rows.ja: 競合(Manhattan Associatesの年次報告に記載)
rows.en: Competitors (named in Manhattan Associates' annual report)

companies.name: パナソニック ホールディングス

relations.text: 年次報告が、サプライチェーン実行・計画の競合としてBlue Yonder/Panasonic(旧JDA)を挙げている
relations.text_en: The annual report names Blue Yonder/Panasonic (formerly JDA) among supply chain execution and planning competitors

source.label: Manhattan Associates 10-K
source.quote: • Supply chain execution and planning vendors, including Blue Yonder/Panasonic (formerly JDA), E2Open, Infios (formerly Korber, HighJump), SAS Institute, the Sterling Commerce division of IBM, Relex, and others;
source.note: Blue Yonder/Panasonicとしての記載です。

relations.text: 年次報告が、競合としてIBMのSterling Commerce部門を挙げている
relations.text_en: The annual report names the Sterling Commerce division of IBM as a competitor

source.label: Manhattan Associates 10-K
source.quote: • Supply chain execution and planning vendors, including Blue Yonder/Panasonic (formerly JDA), E2Open, Infios (formerly Korber, HighJump), SAS Institute, the Sterling Commerce division of IBM, Relex, and others;
source.note: 部門レベルの記載です。

note.ja: 公式資料で確認できた関係だけを載せています。投資判断を勧めるものではありません。
note.en: Only relationships confirmed in official materials are shown. Not investment advice.
